metadata.title: आदिवासी इलाक़े में सुशासन का ढोल फूट जाता है | Festival of Promises, Reality of Apathy
metadata.description: The Chhattisgarh government has launched *Sushasan Tihar* — a campaign touted as a "festival of good governance," where the Chief Minister himself makes surprise visits to villages to hear people's grievances firsthand. However, beneath the surface of these high-profile visits lies a different reality. This ground report exposes the stark gap between the promises of good governance and the lived experiences of villagers. It uncovers widespread mismanagement, deep-rooted corruption, and systemic apathy that continue to plague the implementation of both state and central welfare schemes. Far from being a genuine effort to improve public welfare, the campaign increasingly appears to be a publicity exercise masking serious administrative failures.
